question: How are the seven divisions related to power-holders?
premises: There are seven divisions of those.
They range from sakala to Shiva.
inference: Seven divisions arise among power-holders from sakala to Shiva.
uncertainties: The exact force of udracita is interpretive.
plain_english: By power-holders with unmanifest powers, seven divisions of those; from sakala to Shiva, in powers with raised self.
